description:
Why this issue exists: state/version.rs bump_state() issues two SQL statements: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE to increment the counter, then a separate SELECT to read the new value. Even without the TOCTOU race (filed separately as a P0 correctness bug), this is an unnecessary round trip on every state-mutating JMAP method call.

What needs to be done: SQLite ≥3.35 supports RETURNING. Replace both statements with: INSERT INTO state_versions (type, version) VALUES (?, 1) ON CONFLICT(type) DO UPDATE SET version = version + 1 RETURNING version. One statement, one round trip, race-free.
title: bump_state: replace two-query INSERT+SELECT with single RETURNING query
